title: Eclipse Invoice Manager
summary: Invoice and billing system for a textile brand dispatching to many stores.
problem: Invoices were typed by hand for every store dispatch. Repeated items, GST and edits made it slow and error-prone.
solution: A guided invoice flow with saved products, customers and GST rules, printable invoices and searchable history.

features.title: Quick invoice
features.description: Pick customer and items; totals and GST calculate themselves.

features.title: Print-ready
features.description: Clean invoice layout ready to print or share as PDF.

features.title: History and search
features.description: Find any past invoice in seconds.

aiNote: AI generated the first version of the invoice templates and edge-case tests for GST calculations.
results: Invoices take minutes instead of a long manual process

testimonial.quote: Outstanding service. The invoice management system streamlined our distribution process and reduced manual confusion for our team.
testimonial.name: Gandhi
